name: Alte Post
beschreibung: The **Alte Post** hotel in **Fieberbrunn** is a traditional establishment at the heart of the community. Located near the valley station of the mountain lifts, it serves as an ideal starting point for hiking and skiing excursions. The guest rooms are furnished in classic **Tyrolean** style while offering modern amenities. The hotel features an integrated restaurant serving **regional cuisine**. A highlight is the building’s historic charm, especially emphasized in the cozy tavern. Guests can also enjoy a wellness area with sauna and steam bath. A tranquil atmosphere and personalized service await visitors.
